messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: high tail latency detected on inference-prod (95th > 1.5s) — suspected KV cache miss spike. Pager: https://pager.example/INC-4821 :rotating_light:
lee: I'm on it, digging into KV metrics and rollout history now.
sasha: thx lee. any customer impact visible yet?
lee: early notes — started ~16:03 UTC after deploy of model variant r4-q2. Cache miss ratio jumped from ~5% -> 38%, active batch sizes dropped, 502 rate up ~0.8%.
lee: quick repro: observed many small KV evictions and high eviction rate in the kvcache metrics (kvcache.evictions/s). Looks like the quantized model changed seq length distribution causing more prefix misses.
tyler: can we hotfix by increasing cache capacity & reducing eviction aggressiveness? or rollback quant profile?
lee: trying a safe rollback of model variant to r4-q1 (non-q2) on 3 nodes now.
lee: command I ran: ```
# rollback model route
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/routes/rollout 
  -d '{"route":"prod/inference","model_version":"r4-q1","strategy":"immediate"}' 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
lee: also bumped kvcache.size_limit from 8GB -> 12GB on the affected pool: `kubectl patch deploy kvcache-pool -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kvcache","env":[{"name":"SIZE_GB","value":"12"}]}]}}}}'`
sasha: nice. do we have numbers after rollback?
lee: rollback completed 16:18 UTC. 95th latency dropped from 1.7s -> 0.35s within 6 minutes, cache miss ratio back to ~6%, 502s down to baseline. I'll keep watching for rebound.
tyler: good. we should still track root cause — why did r4-q2 change eviction behavior? maybe kv key lifetime or different prompt tokenization.
jamie: can we get a quick customer impact summary to SRE docs & support? we need to know which tenants saw errors for postmortem.
lee: impacted tenants (seen in logs): AcmeCorp (sev2 degraded search), BrightHealth (slower chat flows), SearchyLabs (errors during peak). I will extract request IDs and surface to support.
pm-anna: please schedule a postmortem next week. attendees: eng-runtime, infra, SRE, PM, support. propose Wed 09:30 PT?
sasha: Wed 09:30 PT works for me.
lee: I'll create the postmortem draft and link runbook.
lee: action items (initial):
- Reproduce eviction spike locally with r4-q2 and synthetic traces (owner: lee)
- Add kvcache eviction-rate alert (owner: sasha)
- Add specific canary test for quantized variants measuring cache miss ratio and batch size (owner: tyler)
- Update rollout playbook to auto-hold on cache-miss > 15% (owner: jamie)
- Run focused load test with r4-q2 across seq-length distribution (owner: lee)
- Postmortem doc + timelines (owner: lee)
- Customer followups + incident report to affected accounts (owner: pm-anna)

pm-anna: can you add ETA for each action item in the doc? we'll track in the incident board.
lee: yes. I'll populate ETAs today.
sasha: small telemetry ask — can we expose per-model quant-profile kvcache key hit histogram? would help root cause. added to items (sasha).
tyler: also let's audit the quantization changes we shipped (diff) and confirm no unintended tokenization logic changed.
jamie: agreed. add that as a code-review item.
lee: created postmortem doc: https://confluence.example/redwood/INC-4821 — initial timeline + action items. I'll update as we confirm ETAs.
oncall-bot: Pager resolved: INC-4821 closed by lee at 16:24 UTC.
lee: closing notes — short-term mitigation: rollback r4-q2 and increased cache size. Long-term: automated canary checks for cache miss ratio and stricter rollout gates for quantized profiles.
pm-anna: thanks team — we'll review action progress in next remediation sync.
jamie: adding to remediation board now. :white_check_mark:
